messages:
maria_ae: Heads-up: GCP marketplace asked for a multi-arch refkit (amd64 + arm64) for our edge inference sample. They want Terraform + Helm + a marketplace tile. Can we map owners and a short plan?

sam_k: I can own CI and image builds. Do we have a required artifact list from GCP?

partner_pm: GCP wants: manifest.yaml, deployable image(s) (multi-arch or separate tiles), IaC examples (Terraform), a quickstart README, and an automated smoke test. Also machine type compatibility notes.

jia_w: noted. For images we should produce: a multi-arch manifest (amd64/arm64) using docker buildx + qemu for cross-builds, and a native arm64 build on Ampere CI for perf verification.

alex_p: sharing a small Terraform example for GKE node pool we used in labs, adapt as needed:```hcl
resource "google_container_node_pool" "inference_pool" {
  name       = "inference-pool"
  cluster    = var.cluster_id
  node_count = 2

  node_config {
    machine_type = var.machine_type  # e.g. a2-highgpu-1g or n2d-highmem-4
    oauth_scopes = ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"]
    labels = { role = "inference" }
    taint = [{ key = "dedicated", value = "inference", effect = "NO_SCHEDULE" }]
  }
}
```

maria_ae: good. we need to add module variables: `machine_type`, `image_type` (COS/ubuntu), `node_arch` (amd64/arm64) and an optional `kms_key` for secrets.

eng_security: add note: manifest and README must state how customers can wire KMS/HSM for model keys and audit logs. provide example using Secret Manager with CMEK.

sam_k: CI plan: GitHub Actions matrix for amd64, arm64-emulated (buildx+qemu), and a partner-hosted arm64 runner for native. Publish multi-arch manifest to ghcr and a GCR mirror for marketplace. Smoke test will deploy and call /v1/predict.

ci_bot: Partner workspace created: https://redwood-internal/partners/spaces/gcp-multiarc-refkit. Checklist uploaded. :white_check_mark:

jia_w: marketplace packaging detail: GCP will accept a container tile referencing a container image and a deploy script (Terraform/Helm). If multi-arch is tricky for review, we can ship two tiles (amd64 + arm64) and link them in the listing.

alex_p: packaging doc TODOs: top-level README, terraform example using `module.gke_inference`, Helm chart values for replicas/taints, troubleshooting section for GPU quota, and rollback steps.

maria_ae: timeline: partner PM wants a preview demo on Tuesday. Let's aim to freeze artifacts by Sunday night.

sam_k: I'll target CI green by Saturday; will add nightly cross-arch build and a smoke-deploy job.

eng_security: I'll draft the security snippet for README showing CMEK + Secret Manager + IAM roles and a sample audit log query.

partner_pm: Also include a small note in docs about graceful fallback: route to a cpu-based model variant if GPU SKUs are unavailable in the region. Customers ask for that.

alex_p: adding fallback guide and a short policy example showing route priorities.

maria_ae: responsibilities: sam_k = CI/builds, jia_w = README + manifest + terraform example, eng_security = security snippets, alex_p = packaging + helm values. we'll do a dry-run publish to a private test listing.

ci_bot: Demo environment ready: https://gke-test.redwood/edge-demo (token in partner workspace).

sam_k: smoke test command (will include in repo):```bash
TOKEN=<DEMO_TOKEN>
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"input":"hi"}' \\
  https://gke-test.redwood/serve/v1/predict | jq '.result'```

maria_ae: perfect. sync tomorrow 9am PT to run through the demo checklist. Ping me if you hit any machine type or quota errors. :rocket:
